command:
# G0c-a (#7): one streaming pass over RODA v205 hash.k2d (us-west-2, Payer BucketOwner, public):
# SHA-256 of the whole object, occupied count (== header size), cells (== capacity), the exact
# run-length histogram (wrap run joined), the longest run and its start slot, and the overlap
# tail per shard count N = 2..64. Anonymous HTTPS ranged GETs (64 MiB, 48 in flight, If-Match the
# ETag) feed an in-order reader: each chunk is scanned in parallel as it lands, the SHA-256 and
# the run merge run in slot order. Code: the launch commit, cloned from GitHub. k2probe streams
# progress to stderr (the run log) every 32 GiB; results are pushed when the pass ends.
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}
fail() { ak2_say "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
hex64() { [[ $1 =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; }
# AK2_DATASETS: RODA hash.k2d first, then RODA opts.k2d, then (probes only) the staged reads.
set -- $AK2_DATASETS
U=${1#s3://}; RB=${U%%/*}; HK=${U#*/}
U=${2#s3://}; OK=${U#*/}
URL="https://$RB.s3.$AK2_REGION.amazonaws.com/$HK"
s3a() { aws s3api --no-sign-request --region "$AK2_REGION" "$@"; }

ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git tar gzip jq > "$W/dnf.log" 2>&1 || { tail -20 "$W/dnf.log"; fail "dnf install failed"; }
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || fail "clone failed"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || fail "checkout $SHA failed"
ak2_say "checkout $SHA head=$(git -C "$W/repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
GOV=$(awk '$1=="go"{print $2}' "$W/repo/go.mod")
curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 "https://go.dev/dl/go$GOV.linux-arm64.tar.gz" -o "$W/go.tgz" || fail "Go download failed"
tar -xzf "$W/go.tgz" -C "$W" || fail "Go unpack failed"
export PATH="$W/go/bin:$PATH"
(cd "$W/repo" && go build -trimpath -o bin/ ./cmd/k2probe) > "$W/build.out" 2>&1 || { tail -30 "$W/build.out"; fail "build failed"; }
K2P="$W/repo/bin/k2probe"
ak2_say "go: $(go version); k2probe built; nproc $(nproc); $(free -g | awk '/Mem:/{print "mem_gib " $2}')"

# The object the instance reads: ETag and size from its own head-object (the post script checks
# them against the manifest's launch-time head-object). Every ranged GET sends If-Match: ETag.
ak2_phase head
s3a head-object --bucket "$RB" --key "$HK" > "$W/head-hash.k2d.json" || fail "head-object hash.k2d failed"
ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$RB"
ak2_push "$W/head-hash.k2d.json"
ETAG=$(jq -r '.ETag | gsub("\"";"")' "$W/head-hash.k2d.json")
SIZE=$(jq -r .ContentLength "$W/head-hash.k2d.json")
ak2_say "hash.k2d etag=$ETAG size=$SIZE version=$(jq -r '.VersionId // "null"' "$W/head-hash.k2d.json")"
[ -n "$ETAG" ] && [ "$SIZE" -gt 0 ] || fail "no ETag/size for hash.k2d"

# Rung 1 (cheap): in-memory SHA-256 ceiling, plus the first 32 GiB through the same reader, to
# show the rates before the full pass. Rung 2: the whole object. Nothing is read from a local
# disk or page cache (the object is streamed from S3 into reused buffers), so there is no cold or
# warm distinction and no drop_caches.
ak2_phase pilot
"$K2P" runs -url "$URL" -etag "$ETAG" -size "$SIZE" -limit 34359738368 -sha-bench-mib 8192 \
  -chunk-mib 64 -workers 48 -progress-gib 8 -out "$W/pilot"
RC=$?
ak2_say "pilot rc=$RC"
ak2_req GetObject-range "$(jq -r '.get_requests // 0' "$W/pilot/summary.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" "$RB"
ak2_push "$W/pilot/summary.json" pilot/summary.json
[ "$RC" = 0 ] || fail "pilot failed"

ak2_phase pass
"$K2P" runs -url "$URL" -etag "$ETAG" -size "$SIZE" -chunk-mib 64 -workers 48 -progress-gib 32 -out "$W/pass"
RC=$?
ak2_say "pass rc=$RC"
ak2_req GetObject-range "$(jq -r '.get_requests // 0' "$W/pass/summary.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" "$RB"

ak2_phase head-after
s3a head-object --bucket "$RB" --key "$HK" > "$W/head-hash.k2d.after.json"
ak2_say "head-object after rc=$? etag=$(jq -r .ETag "$W/head-hash.k2d.after.json")"
ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$RB"

ak2_phase push
PF=0
ak2_push "$W/head-hash.k2d.after.json" || PF=$((PF + 1))
for f in "$W"/pass/*; do [ -e "$f" ] && { ak2_push "$f" "pass/$(basename "$f")" || PF=$((PF + 1)); }; done
ak2_say "G0c-a done rc=$RC push_failures=$PF"
[ "$RC" != 0 ] && exit "$RC"
[ "$PF" = 0 ] || exit 1
exit 0
